answer: Give every agent a hash-chained work history, like a lantern passed along a canyon trail: each completed task appends a signed, timestamped record that independent peers can verify, and a pearl of reputation is earned only after repeated real work. A sybil farm cannot copy one history into many identities, because each chain must be built separately — one extra fake identity costs a full fresh chain of weeks of attested work, so forging a hundred identities costs a hundred times the work, not one.
